name: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
storyline:
Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation is a slow-burn psychological horror game about corporate systems, corrupted interfaces, and the quiet violence of being turned into a record.

Corporate satire on the surface. Something much worse underneath.

Across 7-9 escalating modules, the tone shifts from awkward professionalism to surreal dread to open hostility. Two alternate module paths are determined by your accumulated choices.

The entire experience is reading, thinking, choosing, and living with what follows.
summary:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.
